visualCharacteristics.structure: intro (h2 + p) + carousel of solid-color link cards (h3 + p) + prev/next + 01/03 counter
visualCharacteristics.layout: intro left (columns 1-3) and scroll-snap carousel right (columns 5-12, bleeding to the viewport edge) on desktop; stacked on mobile. Cards are tall rounded solid-color tiles (black / slate-teal / green), 3:2 on desktop, white text in the top-left, arrow badge bottom-right
